name: zombies
title: ZOMBIES
notes: Cross an explore world to a refuge with up to three bots, through zombies sent by a director (notes/ZOMBIES.md). Real guns, carried tighter than elsewhere: a melee weapon, the pistol, a shotgun and an assault rifle to start, more in caches on the way. On foot only, and the ground matters: marsh, rock and sand are slower going.
help: Three legs: two refuges, then hold out at the extraction until the way out opens. Shots draw them; caches have guns. X tells the bots to hold or follow.
